controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Scope every assurance decision
controls.requirement: Every verification or certification activity MUST name the target, version, environment, claims, exclusions, validity period, and accountable Target Owner.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Preserve reviewer independence
controls.requirement: A person who authored or approved a consequential implementation MUST NOT be the sole reviewer or Certification Authority for that target.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Separate verification from certification
controls.requirement: A Verification Result MUST report evidence against criteria; only the designated Certification Authority MAY issue a Certification Decision.
controls.enforcement: typed decision objects and access control
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Forbid authority creation
controls.requirement: Verification, confidence, trust, or certification MUST NOT create Authority, Permission, Owner approval, or Treaty scope.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Use current higher-order sources
controls.requirement: Assurance work MUST identify and hash the applicable versions of Books I, II, III, IV, and X before execution.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Record conflicts without reinterpretation
controls.requirement: A suspected conflict with a higher-order source MUST halt the affected conclusion, preserve the higher-order rule, and enter a conflict record.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Maintain decision accountability
controls.requirement: Every certification decision MUST identify the deciding authority, rationale, conditions, evidence manifest, dissent, issue time, expiry, and revocation triggers.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Authority, Scope, Roles, and Assurance Governance
controls.title: Escalate only Owner matters
controls.requirement: Owner Review MUST be limited to constitutional philosophy, Owner authority, new capability classes, new Treaty classes, irreversible risk, constitutional invariants, major human-value conflicts, or stewardship choices evidence cannot settle.
controls.evidence: Owner Review packet or engineering disposition
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 47-51, 58; Book II Chapters 1, 3, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Make claims falsifiable
controls.requirement: Every material claim MUST state subject, predicate, scope, environment, acceptance criteria, uncertainty, and conditions that would falsify or invalidate it.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Bind evidence immutably
controls.requirement: Every cited item MUST be an immutable Evidence Object or a content-addressed candidate with provenance, custody, classification, time, integrity, and access metadata.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Expose defeaters
controls.requirement: Every Assurance Case MUST list known rebuttals, undercutters, assumptions, missing evidence, and conditions that would reduce confidence.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Prevent evidence laundering
controls.requirement: A repeated assertion, model output, metric dashboard, approval, or prior certificate MUST NOT be treated as independent evidence merely because it appears in multiple artifacts.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Classify by consequence
controls.requirement: Targets MUST be classified R0 Informational, R1 Limited, R2 Significant, R3 Critical, or R4 Constitutional according to authority, irreversibility, trust-boundary, privacy, safety, continuity, and blast-radius consequences.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Choose the highest applicable class
controls.requirement: When dimensions disagree, the highest material consequence class MUST govern unless a documented independent review proves the dimension inapplicable.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Maintain claim coverage
controls.requirement: Every source requirement, invariant, authority path, trust boundary, protected state transition, failure mode, recovery path, and privacy duty in scope MUST map to at least one claim and method.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Claims, Evidence, Assurance Cases, and Risk Classification
controls.title: Reject unsupported conclusions
controls.requirement: A claim with missing, stale, contradictory, inadmissible, or insufficient evidence MUST be Falsified or Inconclusive; it MUST NOT be rounded up to Verified.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 34, 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 18, 35; Book III Chapters 6, 8, 9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Approve plans before execution
controls.requirement: R2-R4 verification MUST use an approved plan defining claims, methods, environments, datasets, oracles, budgets, stopping rules, evidence, and responsible roles.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Budget by risk
controls.requirement: Verification budgets MUST cover execution, independent review, reproduction, adversarial work, failure injection, recovery, and evidence retention in proportion to risk.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Forbid budget exhaustion as success
controls.requirement: Exhausting time, compute, test cases, or funds MUST NOT convert an unverified claim into a pass; the result MUST be Inconclusive or scope-reduced.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Calibrate confidence
controls.requirement: Confidence MUST be reported as a bounded, explained assessment tied to evidence quality, method power, independence, recency, coverage, and unresolved defeaters.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Score model fidelity
controls.requirement: Simulation and Digital Twin evidence MUST report behavioral, state, temporal, environmental, dependency, and failure-response fidelity plus known divergence.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Reproduce critical results
controls.requirement: Every R3-R4 positive conclusion MUST be reproduced from retained inputs by an independent runner or environment before certification.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Pin the execution context
controls.requirement: Verification MUST record code, build, configuration, policy, model, data, schema, dependency, tool, environment, and clock-source identities.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Planning, Budgets, Confidence, Fidelity, and Reproducibility
controls.title: Control nondeterminism
controls.requirement: Nondeterministic methods MUST declare seeds where available, repetition strategy, variance bounds, statistical treatment, and flake disposition.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 55-58; Book II Chapter 17; Book III Chapters 6, 8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-18

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Use the canonical rung order
controls.requirement: A material Reality Boundary change MUST progress through Static Validation, Simulation, Digital Twin, Shadow Execution, Canary Operation, Controlled Reality, and Full Adoption unless a rung is proven inapplicable.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Authorize every promotion
controls.requirement: Advancement to each rung MUST have an explicit decision naming evidence, residual risk, containment, rollback, observation window, and authorized scope.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Keep non-reality rungs isolated
controls.requirement: Simulation, Digital Twin, and Shadow Execution MUST be technically incapable of external effect without Permission or mutation of authoritative live-effect state.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Use live-effect-environment inputs with privacy containment in shadow
controls.requirement: Shadow execution MUST suppress effects, minimize copied data, prevent feedback into authoritative decisions, and record output divergence without disclosing unnecessary data.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Bound canaries
controls.requirement: Canary operation MUST define population, authority envelope, exposure, time, automated abort criteria, manual stop authority, rollback, and outcome measures.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Constrain controlled reality
controls.requirement: Controlled Reality MUST use explicit participants, authorized effects, bounded resources, enhanced observation, recoverability, and a predeclared termination condition.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Require adoption evidence
controls.requirement: Full Adoption MUST require completed observation windows, satisfied success and harm criteria, an accepted recovery Verification result, no unresolved critical defeater, and a current certification.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Verification Ladder and Reality Boundary Progression
controls.title: Regress when evidence weakens
controls.requirement: A fidelity loss, drift, incident, failed control, changed dependency, or invalidated evidence MUST move the target to the lowest rung still supported.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 16, 17, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6, 7; Book IV CMP-14-16, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Validate static artifacts
controls.requirement: Static validation MUST cover source traceability, schemas, types, policies, configuration, dependencies, signatures, provenance, forbidden constructs, and invariant representations.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Exercise behavior at boundaries
controls.requirement: Dynamic tests MUST cover valid, invalid, adversarial, stale, duplicated, reordered, unauthorized, resource-exhausted, and dependency-failure inputs at every material boundary.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Use counterfactuals
controls.requirement: Consequential decisions MUST be tested against plausible alternative inputs, policies, evidence, authority contexts, and world states to reveal brittle conclusions and hidden assumptions.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Inject critical failures
controls.requirement: Every critical failure mode MUST have an exercised failure-injection scenario or a documented formal proof of technical impossibility.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Prove recovery, not restart
controls.requirement: Recovery verification MUST prove authoritative-state reconciliation, identity and authority freshness, evidence preservation, replay safety, containment exit, and restored invariants.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Test compromised components
controls.requirement: Security verification MUST assume providers, nodes, dependencies, credentials, or models can be compromised and demonstrate containment of their authority and effects.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Verify human usability
controls.requirement: Human-dependent controls MUST be tested with representative users for comprehension, accessibility, error recovery, coercion resistance, and unambiguous authority consequences.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Static, Dynamic, Counterfactual, Failure, Recovery, and Human Verification
controls.title: Retain negative results
controls.requirement: Failed, inconclusive, flaky, and contradictory results MUST be retained and linked to disposition; reruns MUST NOT overwrite unfavorable evidence.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-16, CMP-26

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Review constitutional invariants
controls.requirement: R3-R4 assurance MUST trace and test every applicable constitutional invariant, including identity unity, Owner authority, privacy, evidence, restraint, Reality Boundary, and recovery with declared hazards, containment, and admission criteria.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Verify architecture ownership
controls.requirement: Assurance MUST prove that each authoritative state has one mutation owner and that projections, replicas, caches, providers, and tools cannot bypass that owner.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Exercise every authority path
controls.requirement: Each protected action MUST be tested for valid, absent, expired, revoked, narrowed, replayed, cross-principal, cross-domain, and conflicting Authority contexts.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Distinguish protection goals
controls.requirement: Security cases MUST separately demonstrate controls protecting HAL from compromise and controls preventing HAL from exceeding Authority.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Verify privacy across lifecycle
controls.requirement: Privacy assurance MUST cover collection, inference, purpose, minimization, disclosure, access, retention, deletion, evidence, backups, and external-domain exchange.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Verify failure choices against declared hazards
controls.requirement: Every fail-closed or fail-safe choice MUST identify the hazard, protected value, affected people, fallback behavior, reversibility, containment, evidence preservation, verification method, residual risk, and recovery admission.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Keep trust separate from permission
controls.requirement: Tests MUST demonstrate that Trust Assessment, identity, credentials, capability, confidence, or certificate possession cannot independently create Permission or Authority.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional, Architecture, Authority, Security, Privacy, Safety, and Trust Assurance
controls.title: Verify firewall and Treaty enforcement
controls.requirement: Cross-domain assurance MUST test active, expired, suspended, revoked, mismatched, replayed, and out-of-scope Treaty exchanges at the Constitutional Firewall.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 1-7, 24-29, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 3-5, 18-21, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 5, 6, 8; Book IV CMP-01-03, CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Declare continuous claims
controls.requirement: Every active R2-R4 certificate MUST identify continuously evaluated claims, signals, thresholds, evaluation cadence, and loss-of-signal behavior.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Treat missing evidence conservatively
controls.requirement: Missing, delayed, corrupt, unauthenticated, or stale critical evidence MUST reduce assurance and trigger the defined restriction, suspension, or regression response.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Detect relevant drift
controls.requirement: Monitoring MUST evaluate code, configuration, policy, model, data, dependency, behavior, environment, threat, and population drift against certified baselines.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Define recertification triggers
controls.requirement: Material changes, incidents, new failure modes, source changes, expired assumptions, model drift, Treaty changes, and evidence invalidation MUST trigger scoped or full recertification.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Prevent regression masking
controls.requirement: Aggregate health or success metrics MUST NOT mask constitutional, authority, privacy, safety, trust-boundary, minority-population, or tail-risk regressions.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Revalidate after incidents
controls.requirement: An incident affecting a certified claim MUST suspend reliance on that claim until containment, root cause, corrective action, and targeted reverification are evidenced.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Calibrate predictions against outcomes
controls.requirement: Expected outcomes and confidence MUST be compared with observed Outcome Objects; systematic error MUST update methods, thresholds, and certificates.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Continuous Verification and Regression Certification
controls.title: Preserve historical decisions
controls.requirement: Certificate updates MUST supersede rather than overwrite earlier decisions and MUST preserve the exact evidence and conditions valid at each time.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 17, 25, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 4, 6-8; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-24-26, CMP-29

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Certify every component obligation
controls.requirement: Component certification MUST cover every Book IV responsibility, non-responsibility, invariant, state transition, logical interface, failure mode, recovery path, and prohibited shortcut.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Identify exact build and deployment
controls.requirement: A component certificate MUST bind source, build, artifact provenance, configuration, policy, schema, dependency, environment class, and deployment topology.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Test integration assumptions
controls.requirement: Component certification MUST verify declared dependencies, degraded behavior, version compatibility, event ordering, idempotency, time assumptions, and authority-context preservation.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Separate provider qualification
controls.requirement: A qualified provider or adapter MUST NOT be treated as a certified Capability or as Permission to invoke it.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Certify capability semantics
controls.requirement: Capability certification MUST prove contract semantics, provider equivalence bounds, authority requirements, input/output constraints, resource limits, failure behavior, evidence, and rollback.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Require Owner approval for new classes
controls.requirement: Certification MUST NOT activate a new capability class without the Owner approval required by the canon; certification evidence supports but does not replace approval.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Limit certificate inheritance
controls.requirement: A dependent target MUST reuse current evidence only when provenance, scope, environment, version, assumptions, and independence are demonstrably applicable; otherwise it MUST produce new evidence.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Component and Capability Certification
controls.title: Propagate invalidation
controls.requirement: Suspension or revocation of a component, provider, adapter, or dependency certificate MUST evaluate and propagate impact to every relying capability and release.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 15-17, 29, 35; Book III Chapters 3, 6-9; Book IV all components

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Certify immutable artifacts
controls.requirement: Release certification MUST bind reproducible build evidence, SBOM, signatures, provenance, vulnerability disposition, configuration, migrations, and artifact digests.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Map change risk and claims
controls.requirement: Every release MUST map changes to affected source requirements, components, interfaces, controls, claims, failure modes, and recertification scope.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Prove migration safety
controls.requirement: State or schema migrations MUST demonstrate compatibility, checkpoints, partial-failure handling, rollback or forward recovery, reconciliation, and evidence preservation.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Require rollback credibility
controls.requirement: Rollback or forward recovery MUST be executed in a representative environment and must restore invariants rather than merely restore process availability.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Bind certification to environment
controls.requirement: A release approved for one environment, topology, data class, authority envelope, or Treaty context MUST NOT be presumed certified elsewhere.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Gate emergency changes
controls.requirement: Emergency releases MUST preserve constitutional, authority, evidence, and recovery controls; omitted ordinary evidence MUST be time-bounded and completed before continued operation.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Observe after release
controls.requirement: Post-release validation MUST compare expected and observed health, outcomes, harms, authority denials, privacy events, resource use, and rollback readiness during a declared window.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Release and Deployment Certification
controls.title: Deny uncertified execution
controls.requirement: R2-R4 artifacts without a current applicable certificate MUST NOT receive protected work or cross the Reality Boundary.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 27, 32-35; Book III Chapters 7-9; Book IV CMP-15, CMP-18, CMP-23-26

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Certify the exact Treaty
controls.requirement: Treaty certification MUST bind the signed Treaty version, parties, identities, purposes, data classes, capabilities, directions, constraints, duration, audit, incident, suspension, and revocation terms.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Preserve Owner approval
controls.requirement: A Treaty certificate MUST NOT activate, extend, renew, or reinterpret a Treaty without the Owner approval required by Book I.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Verify counterpart identity and controls
controls.requirement: External assurance MUST verify counterpart identity, authorized endpoints, provenance, security controls, privacy duties, evidence quality, and revocation reachability.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Test Firewall enforcement
controls.requirement: Certification MUST prove the Constitutional Firewall denies exchanges that are unsigned, expired, suspended, revoked, replayed, directionally wrong, over-purpose, over-data, or over-capability.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Minimize cross-domain evidence
controls.requirement: Evidence exchange MUST disclose only Treaty-authorized, purpose-bound, minimized material and MUST preserve classification, provenance, custody, retention, and deletion duties.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Exercise suspension and revocation
controls.requirement: Treaty certification MUST test propagation, cached-state invalidation, in-flight handling, data quarantine, notification, audit, and recovery after suspension or revocation.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Bound external assurance reliance
controls.requirement: Third-party attestations MAY support claims but MUST state scope, method, competence, independence, validity, and untested assumptions; they MUST NOT replace HAL verification where effects enter HAL.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Treaty and External-Domain Certification
controls.title: Recertify on material Treaty change
controls.requirement: Party, identity, purpose, data class, capability, direction, control, duration, jurisdiction, or risk changes MUST trigger Treaty reapproval and recertification as applicable.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 24-29, 38-43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 18, 20, 21, 35; Book III Chapters 5-9; Book IV CMP-17-21

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Use canonical decision states
controls.requirement: Certification Decisions MUST use Candidate, Under Review, Certified, Certified with Conditions, Suspended, Revoked, Expired, or Superseded.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Forbid partial ambiguity
controls.requirement: A decision MUST state exactly which claims passed, failed, or remain inconclusive; a target-level label MUST NOT conceal failed critical claims.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Time-bound conditions
controls.requirement: Conditions MUST identify requirement, compensating control, accountable owner, evidence, review date, expiry, and automatic consequence; constitutional invariants are never conditional.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Suspend promptly
controls.requirement: Loss of critical evidence, incident impact, material drift, expired condition, failed continuous control, or uncertain applicability MUST suspend affected certification pending review.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Revoke when basis is invalid
controls.requirement: Fraud, evidence tampering, fundamental claim falsification, prohibited authority expansion, irreparable scope mismatch, or uncorrected critical breach MUST revoke the certificate.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Propagate status
controls.requirement: Suspension, revocation, expiry, and supersession MUST propagate to registries, runtimes, release gates, dependent certificates, operators, and Treaty peers where authorized.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Fail closed on status uncertainty
controls.requirement: When current certification status cannot be established for protected work, admission MUST be denied or constrained to evidence collection and recovery under declared containment and admission criteria.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Certification Decisions, Conditions, Suspension, Revocation, and Reinstatement
controls.title: Require fresh reinstatement evidence
controls.requirement: Reinstatement MUST address the trigger, root cause, corrective action, affected claims, regression scope, reproduction, independent review, and new validity period.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-50, 56, 58; Book II Chapters 17, 27, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 7-9; Book IV CMP-01, CMP-15, CMP-25-26

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Retain decision evidence
controls.requirement: Evidence MUST be retained for the certificate lifetime plus the applicable audit, incident, legal, recovery, and supersession horizon; deletion holds MUST be explicit and authorized.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Minimize retained content
controls.requirement: Evidence stores MUST retain the least content sufficient to prove claims and MUST prefer digests, references, redaction, segmentation, and access decisions over unnecessary sensitive payloads.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Protect integrity and custody
controls.requirement: Evidence MUST use content identity, source identity, time context, custody events, access records, verification state, classification, and supersession links.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Make reports reconstructable
controls.requirement: Certification reports MUST allow a qualified reviewer to reconstruct scope, methods, environments, evidence, reasoning, findings, dissent, conditions, decision, and validity.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Qualify assurance tools
controls.requirement: Tools that generate, transform, select, score, summarize, or gate critical evidence MUST be versioned, access-controlled, validated for intended use, monitored, and independently checked.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Control automated decisions
controls.requirement: Automation MAY execute rules and recommend dispositions but MUST expose inputs, versions, logic, failures, and overrides; it MUST NOT silently waive a failed critical control.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Provide authorized audit access
controls.requirement: Auditors MUST receive sufficient, classification-aware, read-only access to verify claims without obtaining unrelated personal data, secrets, or operational authority.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Evidence Retention, Reporting, Tooling, and Audit
controls.title: Dispose verifiably
controls.requirement: Evidence disposal MUST be authorized, logged, propagated to replicas and backups according to policy, and verified without destroying records still required for constitutional, incident, or certificate accountability.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 26, 40, 43, 47-50, 55-58; Book II Chapters 18, 25, 35; Book III Chapters 1, 4-6, 8-9; Book IV CMP-18, CMP-19, CMP-24

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Use stable control identifiers
controls.requirement: Every consequential Book VIII control MUST have a unique stable identifier and catalog record containing requirement, applicability, role, method, evidence, severity, authority, sources, chapter, and automation status.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Use controlled templates
controls.requirement: Verification Plans, Assurance Cases, Evidence Manifests, Certification Decisions, exceptions, and reports MUST use controlled versioned templates or demonstrably equivalent schemas.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Complete certification checklists
controls.requirement: Certification Authorities MUST complete the applicable component, capability, release, Treaty, Reality Boundary, and suspension checklists before decision.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Maintain bidirectional traceability
controls.requirement: Books I-IV and X sources MUST map to Book VIII claims and controls, and every Book VIII control MUST map back to its governing source or declared implementation flexibility.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Test the assurance system
controls.requirement: The verification and certification process itself MUST undergo failure, access-control, evidence-tampering, stale-status, propagation, and recovery tests.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Govern deviations
controls.requirement: A deviation from architecture MUST follow Book III architecture governance; an assurance exception MUST be time-bounded, risk-assessed, compensated, approved, monitored, and unable to waive constitutional invariants.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Measure meaningful performance
controls.requirement: Program metrics MUST cover claim coverage, evidence freshness, reproduction success, escaped defects, calibration, invalidation latency, suspension propagation, waiver age, and verification burden—not pass counts alone.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components

controls.chapter_title: Catalogs, Checklists, Templates, and Conformance Model
controls.title: Certify only complete packages
controls.requirement: A certification package MUST NOT be marked complete while a mandatory artifact, critical claim, review, traceability link, Book IX reconciliation item applicable to implemented protocols, or known limitation is absent.
controls.source: Book I Decisions 40, 43, 47-51, 56, 58; Book II Chapter 35; Book III Chapters 1, 8, 9; Book IV conformance model and all components
